sources.title: Large Enough: Mistral Large 2 release announcement
sources.evidence: Dated July 24, 2024; expressly makes Mistral Large 2 available that day as mistral-large-2407, version 24.07, with released instruct weights. Reports 123B parameters, 128k context, multilingual/code capabilities, research licensing and native parallel/sequential function calls.

sources.title: Mistral Large 2.0 official legacy model documentation
sources.evidence: Identifies API mistral-large-2407, version 24.07, July 24, 2024 release and open MRL weights. Its row linking the exact Instruct-2407 checkpoint separately labels Parameters (B)=123 and Active (B)=123. Marks the API retired March 30, 2025.

sources.title: Mistral Large 2.0 official documentation, Markdown
sources.evidence: Fetched successfully with Python urllib. Explicitly lists API mistral-large-2407, release_date 2024-07-24, version 24.07, context length 128k, input text, output text, MRL, and the exact open-weight repository. No PDF input is listed.

sources.title: Official Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407 model card
sources.evidence: Public card explicitly identifies this checkpoint as a dense 123B LLM and documents multilingual text generation, coding, native function calling, JSON output, 128k context and Mistral Research License. It demonstrates Transformer loading and text/tool templates. Its general reasoning claims and CoT benchmark results do not specify a dedicated thinking mode.

sources.title: Official repository configuration metadata exposed by Hugging Face
sources.evidence: Public API identifies architectures=[MistralForCausalLM] and model_type=mistral. Its exposed chat template serializes text messages, available tools, tool calls and tool results. No dedicated thinking control is exposed by this template; that absence does not prove non-reasoning status.

sources.title: Mistral AI Research License, MRL-0.1
sources.evidence: License linked by this exact model's card metadata grants conditional use, modification and redistribution for research purposes. Commercial use requires separate permission/licensing. This is an open-weight release under a restricted research license, not an Apache or unrestricted open-source release.

sources.title: Merged official context configuration correction for Instruct-2407
sources.evidence: July 25, 2024 PR by pandora-s, labeled Mistral AI org, expressly changes max_position_embeddings from 32768 to 131072. The public discussion records timlacroix merging it that day. This establishes the exact native checkpoint boundary underlying the 128k advertised context, independently of provider catalogs.

sources.title: Official Instruct-2407 raw checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Raw config.json and params.json returned HTTP 401 because the model repository is gated. The merged context PR's file diff was also gated. No raw configuration values or tensor-header counts are claimed from these failed requests.

sources.title: Hugging Face aggregate safetensors metadata for the official checkpoint
sources.evidence: API returns BF16=122610069504 and total=122610069504. This hosted aggregate was not independently reconciled against all learned tensors and buffers because checkpoint access is gated; it is not substituted for Mistral's directly disclosed nominal 123B count. No weight payload was downloaded.

name.note: Existing display name is a normalized form of the exact mistral-large-2407 API identity, called Mistral Large 2 or Large 2.0 by the developer. It is not the February or November 2024 revision.

developer.note: Mistral AI publishes the exact release and checkpoint; Mistral is the catalog's normalized developer name.

family.note: The release explicitly places version 24.07 in the Mistral Large series.

release_date.note: The dated launch explicitly offers this exact API name and instruct weights that day. Day precision is supported; the July 25 config correction is not a later model release.

open_weights.note: Mistral released the corresponding instruct weights under MRL. Current gated download access and API retirement do not change the fact of weight release.

license.note: The exact card links MRL-0.1. Research/non-commercial rights are restricted; commercial self-deployment requires separate licensing.

parameters_b.note: Developer-disclosed nominal total, in billions, for this exact July 2024 variant. It is not an exact tensor count. The separate HF BF16 aggregate is 122.610069504B, but full learned-parameter reconciliation was unavailable behind the weight gate.

active_parameters_b.note: The exact official legacy weights row separately discloses Active (B)=123. Preserve its nominal precision; this is not inferred by equating a dense model's total with its active count, and no finer component convention is stated.

architecture.note: The exact model card explicitly says dense. Its official repository metadata declares MistralForCausalLM, and the card uses the official Transformer implementation. No MoE architecture is inferred from other Mistral models.

context_window.note: Advertised 128k is resolved to the native 131072-token configuration by the Mistral-org authored and merged July 25, 2024 correction. The release documentation does not resolve an exact hosted API enforcement limit; this value describes checkpoint context, not proven current endpoint operation.

modalities.note: Exact official model documentation explicitly identifies text input/output. Remove inherited PDF input, for which native support is not established; document ingestion by a serving product is not a model modality.

reasoning.note: The release/card discuss mathematical reasoning and ordinary CoT performance, but neither these sources nor the exposed template establish dedicated native thinking support or explicitly declare it non-reasoning. Clear unsupported baseline false; do not convert benchmark reasoning claims into reasoning=true.

tool_call.note: Exact release documents trained parallel and sequential calls; the card and native template demonstrate tool schemas, calls and results.

description.value: July 2024 Mistral Large 2 instruction model with multilingual text, code generation and native function calling
description.note: Replaces time-dependent flagship wording with variant-specific supported capabilities; does not imply a dedicated reasoning mode.

patch.description: July 2024 Mistral Large 2 instruction model with multilingual text, code generation and native function calling

sources.label: Mistral Large 2.0 nominal total and active counts
Mistral Large Instruct 2407 official model card

patch.notes: Mistral separately discloses nominal 123B total and 123B active parameters; these are not exact counts. Native checkpoint context is 131072, confirmed by a merged Mistral configuration correction; official API documentation advertises 128k without an exact serving boundary. Native modalities are text only. Dedicated reasoning-mode support remains unverified. Released weights use MRL-0.1 with research/non-commercial restrictions. Official docs mark the API retired March 30, 2025.

summary: Added developer-disclosed nominal 123B total and separately labeled 123B active parameters, dense architecture and the Mistral Research License. Confirmed July 24, 2024 release, open weights, native 131072 context and function calling. Removed unsupported PDF modality, cleared reasoning=false to null, and made the description specific to this historical revision. Raw configuration and weights are gated, so the HF aggregate was not promoted to an exact learned-parameter count.
